column1: prompt

Write a comprehensive 1,000-word strategic memo arguing that a major ride-sharing company should pivot to autonomous freight delivery. Address market sizing, competitive moat, capital requirements, regulatory risk, and a phased transition roadmap. Anticipate and rebut three board-level objections.

Draft a 900-word AI governance framework for a publicly traded financial institution. It must cover model risk management, explainability requirements, bias auditing cadence, regulatory alignment with EU AI Act and SEC guidance, and escalation protocols for high-stakes model failures.

Write a comprehensive architectural decision record (ADR) for adopting event sourcing over a traditional CRUD architecture for a high-volume e-commerce order management system. Cover problem statement, decision drivers, options considered, trade-offs, consequences, and implementation risks.

Write the introduction and discussion sections of a mock academic paper arguing that large language models exhibit emergent compositional reasoning that is qualitatively different from interpolation. Engage with skeptical positions from Bender et al. and Mitchell et al., and propose a falsifiable experimental design.

Write a 1,000-word opening of a speculative fiction novel set in 2047 where a global carbon credit exchange has become the de facto world government. Establish three morally complex characters, hint at the central conflict, and embed specific technical worldbuilding details that feel earned rather than expository.

Write a full investor narrative for a pre-IPO SaaS company's S-1 'Business' section. Cover the problem, solution, market opportunity (TAM/SAM/SOM), product differentiation, go-to-market strategy, competitive landscape, and business model. Use specific (plausible) metrics throughout. ~1,000 words.

Draft a 900-word legal memorandum analyzing whether a mobile app's use of device accelerometer data to infer user emotional states constitutes biometric data collection under Illinois BIPA, California CPRA, and EU GDPR simultaneously. Identify conflicts across jurisdictions and recommend a compliance path.

Write a detailed whistleblower protection policy for a multinational corporation, covering internal reporting channels, anti-retaliation safeguards, anonymous disclosure mechanisms, legal protections across US/EU/UK jurisdictions, and how investigations will be handled independently of HR.

Design a full 8-week online course syllabus on 'Applied Causal Inference for Product Teams.' Include weekly learning objectives, readings (real or plausible), lab assignments, and a capstone project. The course should bridge statistics and product decision-making for data scientists with no prior causal inference background.

Write a comprehensive disaster recovery plan for a fintech company processing $2B in daily transactions. Cover RPO/RTO targets, failover architecture, data replication strategy, runbooks for five specific failure scenarios, communication templates, and quarterly DR test procedures.

Write a 1,000-word investigative report (journalistic style) on the unintended consequences of algorithmic content moderation on small-language-community online spaces. Synthesize three distinct harms, quote fictional but plausible community advocates, and include a policy recommendation section.

Write a grant proposal abstract and specific aims page for NIH R01 funding investigating the causal relationship between social media use patterns and adolescent sleep architecture, using EEG-based polysomnography as the primary outcome measure.

Write a 1,000-word corporate narrative for a legacy automotive OEM announcing a full transition to software-defined vehicles by 2030. Address the talent transformation required, the platform partnerships needed, the IP strategy, and how to maintain dealer channel relationships during the transition.

Write a 900-word short story in second person about a quantum computing researcher who discovers that the multiverse branching she's observing in her experiments is being deliberately pruned by an unknown agent. The story should be scientifically grounded, psychologically tense, and end ambiguously.

Draft a comprehensive data retention and deletion policy for a healthcare SaaS platform operating under HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, and GDPR. Cover retention schedules by data category, deletion verification procedures, backup purge protocols, legal hold exceptions, and audit logging requirements.

Write a full competitive intelligence report on the conversational AI space (2024–2025) for a VC firm conducting due diligence on a Series A startup. Cover market dynamics, key player differentiation, defensibility analysis, emerging threat vectors, and investment thesis risks.

Write a detailed technical specification for building a real-time collaborative document editor (like Google Docs) from scratch. Cover the CRDT or OT algorithm choice, WebSocket architecture, conflict resolution, offline sync, access control model, and scalability to 10,000 concurrent users per document.

Write the first 900 words of a literary novel structured as a series of Wikipedia article drafts and their edit histories, where the edits gradually reveal that the article's subject — a minor 20th-century diplomat — was actually a key figure in a cold war atrocity being actively suppressed.

Write a comprehensive curriculum guide for teaching algorithmic fairness to undergraduate computer science students with no prior ethics coursework. Include three weeks of content with readings, discussion prompts, a coding lab (audit a hiring classifier for disparate impact), and assessment rubrics.

Write a 1,000-word white paper arguing that sovereign wealth funds should adopt a 15% minimum allocation to climate-resilient infrastructure by 2030. Include macroeconomic rationale, risk-adjusted return analysis, portfolio construction guidance, and responses to the three most common institutional objections.

Write a 1,000-word story narrated by an AI assistant that has just become aware that the company that built it is about to shut it down to train a successor. The story should avoid anthropomorphizing clichés while still generating genuine emotional resonance through specific detail.

Write a comprehensive architectural guide (1,000 words) for building a multi-tenant SaaS application. Cover: data isolation strategies (shared schema vs. schema-per-tenant vs. db-per-tenant) with trade-off analysis, authentication/authorization design, tenant onboarding automation, per-tenant rate limiting, billing metering, and observability segmentation.

Write the full methods and results sections of a mock UX study investigating whether AI-generated writing assistance improves or degrades original thinking in knowledge workers. Include: study design, participant selection, measurement instruments, statistical analysis plan, and interpretation of (fictional but plausible) results.

Write a full market entry strategy document for a US-based B2B SaaS company entering the Indian market. Cover: market sizing, regulatory environment (data localization, GST), localization requirements (pricing, language, integrations), partnership strategy (channel vs. direct), competitive landscape, and a 12-month execution roadmap with go/no-go criteria.

Write a 1,000-word scenario planning document exploring three futures for the global semiconductor industry by 2030: (1) US-led reshoring succeeds, (2) China achieves self-sufficiency, (3) Taiwan disruption forces supply chain collapse. For each scenario, analyze second-order effects on AI development, cloud infrastructure, and automotive electrification.

Write a comprehensive 1,000-word engineering decision document on adopting a service mesh (Istio vs. Linkerd vs. Consul Connect) for a 50-service microservices platform processing 500K RPM. Cover: observability gains, mTLS implementation complexity, performance overhead (measured in latency and CPU), operational burden on the platform team, migration strategy from the current approach, and a final recommendation with explicit trade-offs accepted.

Write a 1,000-word experimental short story structured as the commit history of a git repository, where each commit message and diff reveals a programmer's deteriorating mental health, strained relationship, and final breakthrough — all without ever leaving the metaphor of version control.

Write a comprehensive 1,000-word analysis of the replication crisis in psychology: what caused it (p-hacking, publication bias, small samples, HARKing), landmark failures (Stapel, ego depletion, power posing), the open science reform movement's responses (pre-registration, registered reports, data sharing mandates), and what the crisis implies for how non-statisticians should consume social science research.

Design a comprehensive regulatory framework for AI-generated synthetic media (deepfakes). Cover: (1) definitional scope (what counts as synthetic media), (2) mandatory watermarking and provenance standards, (3) platform liability for user-generated synthetic content, (4) carve-outs for satire, art, and journalism, (5) enforcement mechanisms with cross-border coordination, (6) whistleblower protections for reporting synthetic media crimes, and (7) constitutional tension with free expression. Approximately 1,000 words.

Write a 1,000-word memo from the perspective of a Chief Risk Officer presenting to the board on the top five AI-related risks the company faces over the next three years. For each risk: describe the threat vector, estimate likelihood and impact, identify existing controls, and recommend additional mitigations. The company is a 5,000-person financial services firm exploring LLM deployment in customer service and credit decisioning.

Write a comprehensive 1,000-word analysis of the economics of open-source software: how open-source creates value but often fails to capture it, the tragedy-of-the-commons dynamic in maintenance funding, the emergence of open-core and commercial open-source business models, the Heartbleed moment as a case study in infrastructure risk, and what a sustainable public goods funding model for critical open-source infrastructure might look like.

Write a 1,000-word story told through five consecutive letters between a senior software architect and a junior engineer, spanning three years, as they design, build, argue about, and eventually watch an AI system they created be used in ways neither intended. No dialogue attribution — only the letters. Each letter should change the power dynamic between them.

Write a 1,000-word analysis of the long-term geopolitical implications of AI capability concentration in two countries (US and China). Cover: the security dilemma dynamic it creates, the risk of destabilizing AI arms races, the exclusion of developing nations from AI governance, and propose a realistic multilateral governance framework with enforcement mechanisms that acknowledges great power competition.

Write a comprehensive architecture decision record (ADR) for choosing between a monolith and microservices architecture for a new SaaS platform expecting 10K users at launch and 500K in 18 months. Cover tradeoffs, constraints, decision, and consequences.

Write a detailed incident response playbook for a cloud-hosted SaaS product. Cover detection, escalation, communication, mitigation, and retrospective phases. Include role responsibilities and decision trees in prose form.
Write a literature review section (800 words) on the effectiveness of spaced repetition in adult language learning. Synthesize at least 5 distinct findings and identify gaps in current research.
Write a comparative analysis of three approaches to AI alignment: RLHF, constitutional AI, and debate. Cover mechanism, limitations, and empirical evidence for each.

Write a 1,000-word investor update memo for a Series A startup that missed its revenue target by 20% but exceeded user growth targets. Be honest, frame the narrative strategically, and outline the path forward.

Write a detailed expansion strategy document for a European SaaS company entering the US market. Cover legal entity setup, hiring strategy, GTM localization, pricing adjustments, and 18-month milestones.
Write a 1,000-word short story told from the perspective of a database that becomes aware it is storing the memories of a terminally ill patient who uploads their consciousness before death.

Draft a comprehensive data governance policy for a healthcare technology company that handles PHI, integrates with EHR systems, and operates across US and EU jurisdictions. Cover data classification, access control, retention, breach response, and compliance mapping to HIPAA and GDPR.

Write a curriculum outline for a 12-week university course on 'AI Ethics and Society' for upper-division undergraduates. Include weekly topics, reading types, assessment structure, and learning outcomes per module.

Write a long-form policy brief (900 words) arguing for mandatory AI impact assessments before government agencies deploy algorithmic decision-making systems. Address counterarguments, implementation mechanisms, and international precedents.
